tasks.short: Complete and send the team's production report to management

steps.what: Collect and enter team output, time and waste facts
Aggregate production totals for the reporting period and team
Reconcile production totals and explain anomalies
Populate the existing management production report
Check final report coverage, explanations and management recipients
Send the approved production report to management

tasks.design: Configure the existing production reporting module in {OPS_SYSTEM} to aggregate checked entries and populate the management report in {DOCS}. Keep source capture, reconciliation and explanations with the assembler; a native {EMAIL} action sends only the final report version whose contents and recipients have been checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Production entries are manually regrouped and copied into a separate report.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production queries and fixed report layouts can reuse the same checked entries.
tasks.still_hard: Missing counts, mixed job boundaries and unexplained scrap require bench knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler recognises when apparent output does not represent usable completed work.
tasks.altitude: The assembler spends less report time regrouping data while retaining explanations and report accountability.

evidence.claim: Evocon's H+H case describes replacing paper and spreadsheet production reporting. It establishes capability context, not the proportions or savings for this team.

assumptions: Boundary is the team assembler's existing periodic report, including its real dispatch to management. The provisional scenario has entered production data followed by manual period/team grouping and report-field copying. Confirm that workflow before using these shares; an already automatic report has no such saving.

In s1 the assembler collects or manually enters job identifier, team, period boundaries, good quantity, rejected quantity, duration and scrap reason from existing station records. Staff's original production capture is not assumed free or replaced by hypothetical scanners; this design retains all focal capture and does not add employee tracking.

Test native production queries and report layouts before custom code. s2 removes explicit grouping and totals, while s4 removes fixed-field copying and layout only; assembler explanations are written in s3. No model invents reasons for downtime.

s1 retains missing-data capture, s3 retains reconciliation and manual aggregation of malformed entries, and s5 retains full coverage, quantity, explanation, period and recipient checking plus report repair. If fallback work exceeds this retained allowance, lower the estimate. Ordinary author saves are retained and ungated.

s6's one point is actual attachment/addressing/dispatch today, separate from a same-system save. Approval binds final report and exact management recipients; any change returns to s5. Delivery receipt checks fit in retained s5 time, with excess faults lowering the benefit.

No management review time or new supervisor work is credited to the assembler. Shares are model estimates, not measured site facts. New uses of personal production data require applicable national consultation and access review.
unknowns: Whether the current report is manually aggregated or already generated
Entry completeness and actual report repair effort
research_questions: Observe reporting and separate capture, aggregation, explanation and copying time
Can the native report reconcile totals and exclude incomplete jobs consistently?

already_counted.description: Original data capture, reconciliation, manual fallback, full report review and repair.

incremental.description: Maintain period/team definitions and report mappings; test totals after production schema changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final production report and management recipient list; any data, explanation or recipient edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 35 aggregation, 20 fixed report-copying and one actual-send point, less two upkeep. Conservative paper-heavy mixed jobs require manual aggregation and custom explanations: only eight aggregation points, four standard report fields and 0.2 point of dispatch disappear; 12.2 minus two = 10.2. Capture remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: An assembler who checks the production story and reconciles its evidence while the native system handles repeat totals and report fields.
skills_to_grow: Reconcile production totals without confusing output with quality
role.ambitious_version: Make the existing management report dependable without moving new data-entry duties onto bench staff.
